## Improved
- Play on: while you control another device, everything you play goes there: songs and videos from any list, search, album, radio or the queue, plus play, pause, skip, seek, play next, add to queue and queue edits. Only bringing playback back to this device plays it here again (#1412)
- Play on: while you control another device that plays music, the music player, the notification and the lock screen show its song, queue and progress, and their buttons, headset buttons and the car control that device (#1412)
- Play on: while you control another device, picking a third one moves what plays to it, and you then control that one (#1412)

## Fixed
- Play on: songs and videos after the first one in a queue another device hands over now show their titles and artists (#1412)
- Play on: a phone that only shows another device's music no longer tells your other devices it has that song paused (#1412)
